FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

MEMBERSHIP PRIVILEGES

Can I use my washes across multiple vehicles in my family?

Yes. Your digital pass allows you to assign unused signature washes to any registered vehicle in your garage by simply notifying the studio reception during check-in.

How does the ceramic annual top-up work?

Our detailers perform a chemical decontamination to unclog ceramic microscopic pores, followed by an application of Gtechniq EXO / CSL booster to restore ultra-gloss and 110° water beading.

How do I track my remaining washes and validity?

Each member receives an official digital pass code (e.g. TDC-VIP-XXXX). Every studio visit is tracked live in our CRM with instant WhatsApp receipts showing your remaining credits.
